check_constraints.name: ck_program_category
check_constraints.sqltext: category::text = ANY (ARRAY['AIRLINE'::character varying, 'HOTEL'::character varying, 'CRUISE'::character varying, 'OTHER'::character varying]::text[])

check_constraints.name: ck_knowledge_status
check_constraints.sqltext: status::text = ANY (ARRAY['DRAFT'::character varying, 'VALIDATED'::character varying, 'PUBLISHED'::character varying, 'REJECTED'::character varying]::text[])

check_constraints.name: ck_option_availability
check_constraints.sqltext: availability::text = ANY (ARRAY['AVAILABLE'::character varying, 'UNAVAILABLE'::character varying, 'UNKNOWN'::character varying, 'CONFLICT'::character varying]::text[])

check_constraints.name: ck_evidence_precision
check_constraints.sqltext: "precision"::text = 'SECTION'::text AND section_id IS NOT NULL OR "precision"::text = 'DOCUMENT_LEVEL'::text AND section_id IS NULL

check_constraints.name: ck_mapping_availability
check_constraints.sqltext: availability::text = ANY (ARRAY['AVAILABLE'::character varying, 'UNAVAILABLE'::character varying, 'UNKNOWN'::character varying, 'CONFLICT'::character varying]::text[])

check_constraints.name: ck_price_availability
check_constraints.sqltext: (availability::text = ANY (ARRAY['AVAILABLE'::character varying, 'UNAVAILABLE'::character varying, 'UNKNOWN'::character varying, 'CONFLICT'::character varying]::text[])) AND (availability::text <> 'UNAVAILABLE'::text OR amount IS NULL)

check_constraints.name: ck_price_combination
check_constraints.sqltext: combination::text = 'ALTERNATIVE'::text AND alternative_group IS NOT NULL OR (combination::text = ANY (ARRAY['REQUIRED'::character varying, 'CONDITIONAL'::character varying]::text[])) AND alternative_group IS NULL

check_constraints.name: ck_price_known_state
check_constraints.sqltext: known_state::text = 'KNOWN'::text AND amount IS NOT NULL AND (amount = 0::numeric OR currency IS NOT NULL) OR (known_state::text = ANY (ARRAY['UNKNOWN'::character varying, 'CONFLICT'::character varying, 'NOT_APPLICABLE'::character varying]::text[])) AND amount IS NULL

check_constraints.name: ck_price_target_scope
check_constraints.sqltext: target_scope::text = 'EXACT'::text AND target_tier_id IS NOT NULL OR target_scope::text = 'ALL_TARGETS'::text AND target_tier_id IS NULL

check_constraints.name: ck_edition_review_target
check_constraints.sqltext: decision::text = 'UNRESOLVED'::text AND target_activity_id IS NULL OR (decision::text = ANY (ARRAY['SAME'::character varying, 'NEW'::character varying]::text[])) AND target_activity_id IS NOT NULL
